description: Run a shell command on a remote server. Default working directory is /root/project. Use for: installing deps, running tests, git operations, builds. For commands over 2 minutes, set background=true to get a job_id you can poll with vm_job_status.

background.description: Run in background, return job ID for polling

server.description: Server name (auto-selects if only one is running)

timeout_ms.description: Timeout in ms (default: 120000). Increase for long builds or test suites.

name: vm_bash
